head: shḏ (< MEA shd cf. SL 973: to testify;)

examples.turoyo: u=ḥaloqo shəḏle aʕle b-u=ḥŭḏ̣ūr d-u=šulṭono w-d-ar=rabe d-i=mamlăke kulle
examples.translation: der Haarscherer ablegte gegen ihn Zeugnis in Gegenwart des Sultans und aller grossen des Reiches
examples.raw: u=ḥaloqo shəḏle aʕle b-u=ḥŭḏ̣ūr d-u=šulṭono w-d-ar=rabe d-i=mamlăke kulle ʻder Haarscherer ablegte gegen ihn Zeugnis in Gegenwart des Sultans und aller grossen des Reichesʼ; 68; 27/49, 50;

examples.translation: nur das, was ich gesehen habe, bezeuge ich
examples.raw: u=mede də-ḥzeli, hayo ko-sohaḏno ‘nur das, was ich gesehen habe, bezeuge ich’; LB 153;

examples.turoyo: Mḥammad bări me d-howe (…) b-karse d-i=emo, aloho kṯule, i=šăhad-aṯe d-ko-səhḏína-la, ʕal əšme d-kətwa u=nbiyo d-aloho
examples.translation: Before Muhammad was born, while he was in his mother’s womb, God had written the creed which we maintain about him (Muhammad), that he is the prophet of God
examples.raw: Mḥammad bări me d-howe (…) b-karse d-i=emo, aloho kṯule, i=šăhad-aṯe d-ko-səhḏína-la, ʕal əšme d-kətwa u=nbiyo d-aloho ‘Before Muhammad was born, while he was in his mother’s womb, God had written the creed which we maintain about him (Muhammad), that he is the prophet of God’ JL 20.7.42;
